sources.snippet: Prompt Guard Tutorial The goal of this tutorial is to give an overview of several practical aspects of using the Prompt Guard model. We go over: The model's scope and what sort of risks it can guardrail against; Code for loading and executing the model, and the expected latency on CPU and GPU; The limitations of the model on new datasets and the process of fine-tuning the model to adapt to them.

sources.title: Llama Prompt Guard 2 | Model Cards and Prompt formats
sources.snippet: Llama Prompt Guard 2 comes in two model sizes, 86M and 22M, to provide greater flexibility over a variety of use cases. The 86M model has been trained on both English and non-English attacks. Developers in resource constrained environments and focused only on English text will likely prefer the 22M model despite a slightly lower attack-prevention rate.
